obligation_class: May this candidate claim be promoted hypothesis/doctrine -> invariant? (does it carry the REQUIRED admission evidence?)
predicate: SchemaValid AND Traceable AND ConstraintCompliant AND NonDegenerate
distinction_compiled: evidence PRESENCE != evidence SUFFICIENCY (D1 checks presence; D2 checks sufficiency)
note_on_output: CANDIDATE != ADMITTED != INVARIANT. This gate only decides evidence-sufficiency; it does not mint admission or authority.
adoption_gate: adopt iff (agreement >= q_min) AND (false_accepts == 0) AND (C_D_total < C_cognition)
